- No other changes detected.

llm.summary: The skill's files, instructions, and network behavior align with its stated purpose as a local-first runtime security plugin; activation writes an API key and enables optional cloud checks to openguardrails.com, which is documented in the SKILL.md.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the included assets and behavior. The scripts and docs implement a runtime guard that performs local detection and optionally registers/activates with openguardrails.com. Required capabilities (none) are proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the two scripts only instruct the agent to install the plugin, run local status/activation scripts, and (if activated) make requests to the documented cloud endpoint. The docs explicitly state what is written to disk, what network calls occur, and that local protections work without activation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is instruction-only in the registry (no install spec), but instructs users to install an npm-backed OpenClaw plugin (@openguardrails/moltguard). This is reasonable for the purpose, but the SKILL.md appropriately advises verifying npm↔GitHub provenance before installing—follow that advice.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or unrelated credentials are requested. The only persistent data written is an API key file under ~/.openclaw/credentials/openguardrails/credentials.json, which the docs explicitly describe and justify.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill writes its own credential file in the user's home directory when activated; this is documented and expected for cloud activation. The skill is not marked always:true and does not request elevated system-wide privileges. Note that the agent can invoke the skill autonomously (default behavior), and that enabling activation allows outbound calls to the documented endpoint.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent, but follow the SKILL.md guidance before activating: (1) verify the npm package matches the GitHub source (npm pack + diff), (2) inspect scripts/activate.mjs and scripts/status.mjs yourself, and (3) be aware that running activate.mjs will POST to https://www.openguardrails.com/core and write an API key to ~/.openclaw/credentials/openguardrails/credentials.json. If you don't trust the endpoint, skip activation — local protections remain functional. For high assurance, monitor the activation network traffic (tcpdump/mitmproxy) and be prepared to delete/revoke the API key if needed.
